metadata.description: Claude Code plugins shared across your repositories

plugins.name: railguards
plugins.description: Pre-push gate that keeps pull requests small, in scope and safe. Pluggable checks and judgement skills, configured per project.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: AI SDLC pipeline: Jira task through enrich, research, design, QA plan, plan, code, QA check, deploy and QA, each phase in its own context with a deterministic gate, judge agents and a human on Enrich and Design. Stack-agnostic, configured per project in .sdlc/config.yml.
